ar.auth_purpose: حضورك وإجازاتك ومكافأتك في مكان واحد.

en.auth_purpose: Your attendance, leave and bonus in one place.
en.auth_setup_later: You can change these later in Settings.

en.auth_forgot: Forgot your password? Ask the system admin for a new one.
en.auth_rule_no_file_number: Does not contain your file number
